senses.gloss: (b. h.; = אשר ל־, v. שֶׁ־) belonging to, of.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:2">Ab. II, 2</cite> <he>בנו של ר׳ וכ׳</he> the son of &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:12">Ib. 12</cite> <he>יהי ממון … כשֶׁלְּךָ</he> let thy neighbor’s property be as dear to thee as thine own.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:10">Ib. V, 10</cite> <he>האומר שֶׁלִּי שלי ושֶׁלְּךָ שֶׁלָּךְ</he> he who says, what is mine is mine, and what is thine is thine.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:1">B. Mets. I, 1</cite> <he>זה אומר כולה שלי וכ׳</he> one says, it belongs entirely to me &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 30a:15">Ib. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>שהיתה מלאכה שֶׁלּוֹ … משל חבירו</he> when his own work is more valuable than that required for his neighbor, i.e. when by helping his neighbor he would lose more than he could save for his neighbor.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:11">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>אמרו לו מה נאמר … שאכלנו מִשֶּׁלּוֹ</he> they (the strangers entertained by Araham) said to him, what shall we say? Said he, say, blessed be the God of the world of whose belongings we have partaken; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 57b:11">Kidd. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>שחוט שלי בשלי וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="L00400"><he>לי</he></cite>) slaughter what is owing to me (the sacrifice) on what belongs to me (on Temple grounds), and what is for thee, on thy own ground.
